name: enbu
description: Manage the team's encrypted .env secrets with enbu, in the same UI as the enbu desktop app.

enbu.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `enbu` binary. Leave empty to use the binary bundled with the extension, or `enbu` on `PATH`. On macOS, point this at the binary that created your device identity: a Secure Enclave key works only with the binary it was created with.

//: Manage Node.js and pnpm versions only in ../aqua.yaml. Do not add engines.node, devEngines, or packageManager; configure Vite+ to use system tools.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: enbu runs the enbu binary against the workspace's enbu.toml and decrypts secrets.
